Raw hex address 0x1c57074 assigned to bare local `this_ptr_00`. The decompiler dropped a symbolic reference — either a data-symbol pointer (recover the symbol from the .asm and replace `this_ptr_00` with symbolic global/array indexing, §11) or a dead code-address store from return-address tracking (delete it, §14). Magic addresses do not survive the relink.

Watcom loop-unrolled memcpy (countdown for-loop with the `(uint)bool * -N + M` direction idiom — Watcom's REP MOVSD lowering fingerprint). Replace the whole loop with memcpy(dst, src, count * stride) or a struct assignment in a .keep.
